review.reason: Adds a new constant SCHEDULED_CHANGE_JOB_TYPE and its usage, replacing a string literal. This is a localized maintenance and compatibility improvement. However, the chunk lacks the definition of the referenced AGENT_TRIGGER_JOB_TYPE and the implementation of activity log fields, preventing a higher tier assignment.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed constant addition and usage, but the absence of the referenced AGENT_TRIGGER_JOB_TYPE definition and activity log implementation limits the assessment. The benefit is not proven, only the code change is observed.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the definition of AGENT_TRIGGER_JOB_TYPE, which is referenced in P1.F2.H4. The chunk also does not include the implementation of the activity log fields (is_system, user_id, was_impersonated) or the _author helper, only the usage and tests. Without the definition and implementation, the tier cannot be assigned.
